references.text: Here reference is made to Isaiah 56:7, where God's house is spoken of as a house of prayer, which Jesus quotes in Matthew 21:13.
Psalm 69:9 regarding zeal for God's house can be seen in connection with Jesus' actions and words in Matthew 21:13.
Mark 11:15-17 gives a parallel account of the event in Matthew 21:13, including the quote about the house of prayer.
Luke 19:45-46 also gives a parallel account of the event in Matthew 21:13, with focus on the house as a house of prayer.
Jeremiah 7:11 is quoted by Jesus in Matthew 21:13, where he criticizes that God's house has been made into a 'den of robbers'.
